name: Claire Baxter
title: Psychologist, Psychoanalyst
description: Claire Baxter works with patients who present with presentations ranging from stress and anxiety, depression, trauma, mood and personality disorders, neurodiversity and gender dysphoria. She offers talking therapy for these and many other conditions. Claire works with adolescents experiencing sadness, depression, anxiety, or gender dysphoria.
specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Sex Related Issues, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Julia Bediaga
title: Social Worker AMHSW
description: Julia Bediaga is an accredited mental health social worker with extensive experience working in a variety of settings. She completed a Master of Social Work and a Bachelor of Arts majoring in Anthropology and Psychology. Julia uses a person-centered, trauma-informed and strengths-based approach to build a supportive space where individuals can feel free to safely explore their thoughts and feelings.
specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma Sensitive Yoga, Trauma-Informed

name: John Cameron
title: Psychoanalyst, Counsellor
description: Psychoanalysis creates a time and space where our most difficult thoughts and feelings can be voiced. By speaking without censorship in a safe and private environment, the unconscious causes of our deepest suffering can be acknowledged and ultimately their grip on our destiny loosened. People can bring a range of symptoms and diagnoses to the psychoanalytic clinic such as: • Depression and anxiety • Schizophrenia, bipolar, borderline or paranoid personality disorders • ADHD, ASD, PTSD and C-PTSD • Phobias, nightmares, insomnia • Addictions and eating problems Or distressing feelings and behaviours related to: • Sexuality or relationships • Anger, fear, panic, stress, shyness, confusion, helplessness, guilt • Suicide and self harm • Obsessive or compulsive thoughts and actions • Problems with identity, existence, parents or children While these categories signify common factors in suffering, every psychoanalysis is unique.
specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Gender and Sexuality, Psychosexual

name: Weiyu Guan
title: Art Therapist, Psychotherapist
description: I work from a deep trust in human connection and in the ever-present web of nature that supports us. I value clients as the artist in their own life, and I am committed to walking alongside each person with curiosity, respect, compassion and presence.
specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Christopher Mether
title: Psychoanalyst, Counsellor
description: Chris is a practicing psychoanalyst with the Australian Centre for Psychoanalysis. He provides a non-judgemental space where both conscious and unconscious thoughts can be explored. His exhibitions presented stories of immigration which often involved loss, trauma and notions of identity.

name: Daniela Miszkinis
title: Art Therapist, Clinical Supervisor
description: I am a Holistic Counsellor with specialisation in Art Therapy (Master of Art Therapy, La Trobe Uni, ANZACATA) and Clinical Counselling & Supervision (ACA). I am an officially registered NDIS Provider. In my integrative and creative practice, I work on my client's self-esteem by affirming their dignity and self-worth, providing emotional outlets and an opportunity to express oneself in a way that is safe and contained, especially when accessing traumatic material. I specialise in trauma-informed care.
specialties: Dissociative Disorders, PTSD, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Paul Reid
title: Psychotherapist, Psychoanalytic Psychotherapist
description: Although we have specific words and labels for many of the difficulties and forms of suffering that we all experience, these labels and terms have little positive effect on these forms of mental and emotional suffering. Through the psychoanalytic process, I can help you to find a way to work through the difficulties that you maybe experiencing. This might including your talking about your initial difficulties but also your fears, desires, sexual life, dreams, relationships and concerns.

name: Estelle Snelling
title: Psychotherapist, Somatic Psychotherapist
description: My work is grounded in the belief that the body holds deep wisdom and the capacity to heal, given the right conditions of safety, connection, and presence. I integrate somatic, attachment-based, systemic, and trauma-informed frameworks to support clients and professionals in cultivating resilience, embodied presence, and system-aware care. My vision is for trauma-informed, body-aware practice to be embedded not just in psychotherapy, but also in staff support, supervision, and broader community and organisational settings. Estelle is a Clinical Psychotherapist with over 25 years of experience in diverse roles spanning trauma-informed psychotherapy, staff support, clinical supervision, and training. Estelle holds a Master’s in Mental Health Sciences and is also trained in EMDR and the Flash Technique.
specialties: Dissociative Disorders, PTSD, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, EMDR, Trauma-Informed
